sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Read-only bounded UIAutomation snapshot of the pinned Fusion process/window; no activation, focus change or action. Returns {status:ready|partial|nothingToDo|blocked|unsupported|unknown, observationId (one-use, ~30s), identityVerified, windows:[{controls:[{name,controlType,automationId,runtimeId,ancestry,visibility,enabled,invokeAvailable,controlRef,containerRef}]}], profiles:[{profileId,controlRef,qualified,matchingMethod,languageIndependent,actualLocale}], activeCommand, process:{fusionVersion,osBuild,locale}, truncated, unavailableEvidence}. matchingMethod is nativeCommand|invariantIds|localizedProfile|callerSelected. An observation is not model acceptance; operationOutcome stays notEvaluated.

sections.title: Language And Qualification
sections.text: Same-host Windows UIAutomation only through the addin backend; non-Windows/non-WSL or a missing process/window/document returns unsupported/partial. Source-derived AutomationIds are candidates, not guarantees: scope by container/ancestry, class, ControlType, Invoke and intent — captions/titles never identify a target alone. A profile without an exact native build/OS/locale qualification is reported but cannot be invoked. The observed Polish profile is not universal; unknown locales remain inspectable and block only when a required localized fallback is unavailable.

examples.label: Inspect a pinned document's modal UI
examples.requires: A coordinator-issued request-bound lease; the pinned Fusion document is open. Same-host Windows UIAutomation via addin.
examples.output: result.observationId plus bounded controls/profiles with actual Unicode names, types and qualified matching methods; an observation is not model acceptance.

verified: read-only snapshot with one-use observation tokens
native UIA/PS1 qualified only for the documented host; no universal profile

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: One authorized, freshly revalidated action: {status:actionSubmitted|blocked|stale|ambiguous|notFound|unknown, actionSubmitted, dialogClosed, nativeCommandId, activeCommand, idle, terminationReason, terminationObservationAvailable, modelUnchanged, matchingMethod, profileId, operationOutcome:notEvaluated, unavailableEvidence}. actionSubmitted, dialogClosed and operationOutcome are separate; a dialog disappearing or a true boolean is not CAD PASS.

sections.title: Cancel Vs Modal And Selection
sections.text: selectionMode profile (a qualified build/OS/locale profile only) or observedControl (exact observed controlRef, or controlName+controlType:Button scoped by an observed containerRef). Observed control text is not action semantics; duplicate controls are ambiguous and block with zero action, and a caller-selected controlRef does not widen intent or authorization. Native cancellation is UserInterface.terminateActiveCommand issued only from a qualified top-level dispatcher for a supported command, never from command event handlers or an atomic batch; Qt/OS modals may remain. Cancellation is qualified only for the measured host (Fusion 2705.1.25 / Windows 10.0.26200.0 / pl-PL): Move = FusionMoveCommand, face Offset = FusionOffsetFacesCommand. The private one-shot PS1 watcher is host-side UIAutomation with no SDK thread; watcher disarm/timeout is not proof the underlying operation was cancelled.

examples.label: Confirm one qualified update dialog
examples.requires: A fresh, unexpired observation from ui.inspect and a qualified update-all-latest profile for this exact build/OS/locale.
examples.output: result.status actionSubmitted with dialogClosed/nativeCommandId; operationOutcome remains notEvaluated until the caller completes domain checks.

verified: observedControl exact-name/container scoping and duplicate ambiguity
native cancel/confirm qualified only for the documented host; no universal profile

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Bounded inspect → one qualified authorized action → reinspect using ui.inspect/ui.respond primitives. Returns {resolutionStatus:resolved|nothingToDo|partial|blocked|unknown, actions, candidates, remainingUI, operationOutcome:notEvaluated, unavailableEvidence}. maxActions defaults to 3 and timeBudgetMs bounds the loop; action exhaustion returns partial, not success. When automatic profile selection is unavailable it returns bounded candidates for ui.respond observedControl under the same authorization, without demanding routine user clicks.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Every step obtains a fresh observation and revalidates process start/window/document/request/lease/profile/control before acting. No retry of pending/unknown original operations, no action on an unknown dialog/intent, no document open/activation, and no implication that UI resolution equals operation success; operationOutcome remains notEvaluated until the caller completes domain checks.

examples.label: Resolve one qualified update confirmation
examples.requires: A coordinator-issued request-bound lease and a locally qualified update-all-latest profile for this host.
examples.output: result.resolutionStatus resolved/nothingToDo/partial/blocked/unknown with action receipts; operationOutcome stays notEvaluated.

verified: bounded loop and fresh revalidation per action
no-replay of unknown originals and notEvaluated domain outcome
native resolution qualified only for the documented host; no universal profile
